## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and validation.

## Product ownership review

- [ ] Tasks / acceptance criteria / model or account selection / placement belong to Hub; bytes / keys / device / human input belong to PocketShell; process / session record belongs to aplexer.
- [ ] Cross-product runtime calls are justified; an optional link cannot serve the need.
- [ ] Removed automation paths stay removed (psc agent automation, push, cards, quota history, MCP server).
- [ ] Each product works while the other is unavailable.
- [ ] A negative boundary test covers this change.
- [ ] Any gray-area change links an approved ADR with intake ID and Alexey approval, and carries `scope:gray`.
